# `set_camera_exp_and_bin`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set exposure and/or bin in one call.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcf420, SetBin @0x11f2b0 (64-bit build) |

Required object (or first array element) with optional integer members exposure and bin. Members are applied in the order they appear on the wire, each immediately; the first failing member stops processing with no rollback, so the call can partially change settings and still return an error. Unrecognised keys, non-integer members and null members are skipped silently; an empty object succeeds. exposure is an integer number of microseconds (10 s is 10000000); its range comes from the camera.

Side effects: Sets camera control 1 (exposure) and the bin immediately, in wire order; partial application on failure.

Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |

| `params` | any | yes | - | Required object, or an array whose first element is that object. Absent, empty array or non-object fails with 107. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | Params missing, empty array or not an object | `expected object param` |
| 318 | Camera is closed | `device not connected` |
| 210 | Bin not in the camera's supported list | `not supported` |
| 204 | Video-page bin outside 1..maximum | `out of limit` |
| 207 | Operation failure whose thread-local error code is zero (the default substituted when the callee set none); other callee-set codes are forwarded unchanged | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Errors from setting control 1 (exposure range) are forwarded and not enumerated.

## Example

Request, both:

```json
{"id":44,"method":"set_camera_exp_and_bin","params":{"exposure":10000,"bin":1}}
```

Request, exposure-only:

```json
{"id":45,"method":"set_camera_exp_and_bin","params":{"exposure":20000}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_camera_exp_and_bin","result":0,"code":0,"id":44}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_camera_exp_and_bin","error":"expected object param","code":107,"id":46}
```
